integrity: The finite classification has two self-contained exhaustive computations with different enumeration and adjacency constructions, both replayed. The known perfect-matching count is attributed to earlier literature; no independent external scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite conclusion only for the Tutte–Coxeter graph under single length-eight alternating-cycle flips. No general cubic-graph, generalized-quadrangle or mixing-time extension is claimed; publication priority is limited by the accessible record.
title: Hamiltonian-union antipodes in the Tutte–Coxeter octagon-flip graph
